source.title: Consumption-investment problems with transaction costs: Survey and open problems

trace.notes: Input URL normalized as zbMATH resolver ID 1441490. Local resolver metadata matched DOI 10.1007/s001860050002 and title. Shell curl failed in the restricted environment with DNS resolution failure for zbmath.org. Web resolution reached the Springer DOI landing page, which exposed only an abstract/subscription preview and buy-PDF access, not the full article text. Exact-work recovery attempts used the DOI, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus author, Springer PDF/fulltext links, CiNii, IDEAS/RePEc, DBLP, and Unpaywall leads; inspected candidates were metadata-only records, paywalled publisher pages, reference-list mentions, or related but different works. Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted and metadata_only; no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the open-problem statements was recovered.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/1441490.json and outputs/latest.json.
